messages:
maria: FYI discovered a medium/7.0 CVE in libc dependency inside our base image. planning a coordinated rebuild + re-sign + canary rollout. need RBAC scoping, short-lived KMS keys, and audit export before prod canary.
jonathan: which services are affected?
maria: scan shows ~12 internal services and 6 customer-facing frontends using that layer. mostly runtime containers.
kevin: for signing we should spin up an ephemeral asymmetric key in KMS (TTL 72h) and grant minimal signer role to the canary principal. avoids touching main signing key.
alex: agree. also insist we pin digest references in canary to avoid :latest surprises. schedule during low traffic.
sam: audit requirements? what to log for compliance?
maria: must capture KMS sign/unwrap calls, cosign signature events, artifact registry pushes, and admission controller allow/deny decisions. retention 365 days for prod.
sec-bot: [vuln-scan] base/ubuntu:libc-2026 flagged CVSS 7.0 at 2026-03-21T09:11Z :warning:
jonathan: can we hotpatch the package instead of rebasing?
maria: hotpatch could be used for quick mitigation but we prefer rebuild to regenerate SBOMs and attestations.
kevin: RBAC change: current build-runner role has kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign broadly. propose new roles/image-rebuilder with kms.sign only on key 'rebuild-2026-03-21' and artifact push rights.
lina: CI needs artifact upload + attestor create permissions. recommend artifactregistry.writer + binaryauthorization.attestorCreator.
alex: suggested runbook: 1) create KMS key rebuild-2026-03-21 (72h) 2) apply RBAC roles/image-rebuilder 3) rebuild in staging 4) sign with cosign 5) run canaries 6) rotate and disable ephemeral key.
jonathan: paste cosign sign example?
kevin: example:
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign-blob --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/rebuild-2026-03-21 --output-signature rebuild.sig ./image.tar
maria: admission controller must verify signatures against allowed key IDs (rebuild-2026-03-21 or main-key) and reject unsigned images.
sam: map these events into SIEM: fields: event.type, actor, key_id, image_digest, admission_result.
kevin: enable log sink:
resource "logging_sink" "sec_logs" {
  destination = "bigquery://sec-logs.dataset.logs"
  filter = "protoPayload.methodName:(\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign\" OR \"google.container.analysis.v1.Notes.Create\") OR resource.type=\"artifactregistry_repository\""
}
lina: jonathan can you own CI pipeline changes?
jonathan: yes, will open GH issue and push pipeline changes.
maria: kevin, please create the key and PR for IAM. include binding TTL and who gets the role.
kevin: creating key now and will open infra PR. assigned to jonathan-ci and canary-sa.
sec-bot: [assigned] vuln-triage -> @maria, please ack within 2h.
maria: acked. scheduling canary at 02:00 UTC in 48h.
alex: rollback plan: if canary fails, unroute, redeploy old digest, revoke ephemeral key, and run postmortem.
maria: checklist posted: [ ] KMS key + IAM PR, [ ] CI pipeline updated, [ ] SBOM & attestations, [ ] Staging canary pass, [ ] Prod canary scheduled, [ ] Log export verified.
jonathan: staging rebuild finished: digest sha256:bbb222...
kevin: infra PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3201 created (WIP).
lina: ticket created RW-5427 with checklist and links.
maria: final question: retention 365d confirmed by legal?
sam: legal confirms 365d ok for these logs.
jonathan: queuing prod canary for 2026-03-23T02:00Z.
kevin: PR merged. key set to auto-disable after 72h.
alex: will monitor canary and alert on 5xx and latency SLO breaches.
maria: thanks team, closing loop. if canary passes in 24h we promote. otherwise rollback and follow runbook. :lock:"
